study_identification_part.si4_title: Multivariate brain-  cognition associations in euthymic bipolar disorder

cm1_research_objectives.reason: Objectives are clearly stated: the study examines multivariate associations between cortical thickness and core cognitive functions in euthymic bipolar disorder (BD). The purpose of applying normative modeling is explicitly to generate robust estimations of cortical abnormalities given small control samples. These satisfy both criteria (stated research question and purpose of normative modeling).
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text:
"We examined multivariate associations between cortical thickness and core cognitive functions in euthymic BD. We used large public neuroimaging datasets to build normative models of cortical thickness to produce robust estimations of structural abnormalities in BD."
"We utilised public datasets to develop normative models of cortical thickness (n = 5977) to generate robust estimations of cortical abnormalities in patients."

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: This study builds a new normative model. It cites original publications for open datasets (OASIS-3, Cam-CAN, OpenBHB, HCP). Image quality and data completeness standards are addressed: all normative data went through FreeSurfer recon-all; outliers were removed per ROI based on residuals >5 MAD (n=393). Local HCs included in the normative set had explicit eligibility criteria (no psychiatric illness, no psychotropic medications) and 1 HC was excluded for poor T1 quality. The final normative sample size used is reported as n=5977.
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text:
"We developed normative models of cortical thickness using large public normative datasets... All data were pre-processed using the standard recon-all pipeline in FreeSurfer... We removed controls who had outliers in any ROI, defined as residuals greater than 5 median absolute deviations (n = 393)." (methods)
"Healthy controls had no history of psychiatric illness and were not taking any psychotropic medications... Exclusion criteria for all participants were: contraindications to MR... current or past medical condition likely to affect brain structure..." (participants)
"Participants were excluded if the T1w images included MR artefacts or were poor quality (n = 1; HC)."
"Abnormality scores were calculated... with a large normative reference sample (n = 5977)."

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: Covariates age and sex are explicitly modeled; multi-site effects are handled by including site (scanning protocol) as a random effect in a generalized additive model when harmonizing cortical thickness in the normative cohort.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text: "...for each ROI by regressing age, sex and scanning protocol (i.e., site; as a random effect) on cortical thickness using a generalised additive model. The correction was performed in R using the package mgcv."

Image quality standards and exclusions are described (exclude poor quality T1; visual QC and manual edits). Final sample sizes and exclusions are reported (BD n=56, HC n=26; 1 HC excluded for poor T1; 3 BD excluded from cognitive analyses).
